kh1fm-enemy-white-mushroom.name: White Mushroom
kh1fm-enemy-white-mushroom.instructions: Respond only to the current gesture: shivering → Fire; fanning itself → Blizzard; light overhead → Thunder; fallen down → Cure; floating → Gravity; frozen in place → Stop; spinning → Aero. Give three correct spells to finish the encounter. Three of the same spell also give that spell's Arts. Wrong attacks or spells end the attempt. Find early spells in Wonderland's Lotus Forest or Deep Jungle's Camp; advanced spell gestures have room-specific availability. The three motionless Tree House/Undersea Cave mushrooms are Pink Agaricus triggers, a different challenge. The stat table uses the stated story phase; MP recovery value is an enemy combat parameter, not a castable MP pool. Damage multipliers of x0 indicate immunity. For three correctly requested spells, mixed spells give the final spell's Shard (100%) and Mystery Goo (10%); three of the same spell give that Arts item (100%), its Gem (10%), and Mystery Goo (20%). Use Fire when it shivers, Blizzard when it fans itself, Thunder under a light, Cure when it lies down, Gravity while floating, Aero while spinning, and Stop while frozen in place. Requested gestures depend on the room. For the advanced Arts, use Camp for Cure, Treasure Room for Gravity, Below Deck for Stop and Graveyard for Aero; Linked Worlds can request all seven. Wait without attacking until the desired gesture appears, then answer that same gesture three times on one Mushroom. Exit and return to reroll the rare encounter; if it does not change, move two rooms away before returning. The permanently stopped Mushrooms in Final Mix Tree House and Undersea Cave summon Pink Agaricus and do not award Stop Arts.
